status: Concept redesign integrated into the ZL80 scanner; calculation and nominal envelope only; not manufacturing release
supersedes: ADF50-V0.2-PDR (folded path, rejected by the user on 2026-11-16) and ADF50-V0.1-PDR; both folders kept unchanged
architecture: in-plane straight-through: flat magazine in front, film plane Z=110 from stack to output, no bend; separator built into the scanner front panel, ejector into the rear panel

tilted_alternative.note: Option C in the trade study: whole optical core rotated so the film runs straight downhill (commercial sheet-film digitizer style). Rough estimate only.

assumptions: Media: developed, fixed, fully dried sheet film, one thickness class per batch, no interleaving paper.
Friction coefficients, modulus, adhesion and all forces are design assumptions, not measurements.
Coordinates are the R5-PDR1 nominal frame (scan line Y=0, film plane Z=110, enclosure 320x300x300, film enters at -Y) with the R5.2 collector layout B (PMT group shifted -12.4 mm in Y).
Scan modes come from the R5.2 photon budget; calculated, not measured.
Dam model is a cantilever beam estimate; feed/retard window is a rigid friction estimate. Both need a transparent mock-up and real film.
